alpha_notes.hex_alpha: 8-digit CSS colour is #RRGGBBAA (alpha in the last two digits), so #FF000080 is red with alpha 0x80 = 128/255 = 0.5019607843137255
alpha_notes.why_not_half: 128/255 and 0.5 differ by 0.0019607843137254902; over two source-over steps with a 255 white backdrop this moves the rounded R/G channels by one unit, so the two alphas cannot be used interchangeably
alpha_notes.group_vs_per_shape: Opacity(0.5) on a group blends the composited layer once; per-shape alpha blends every shape against whatever is below it
alpha_notes.doc_source: ai-guide.md: colours use CSS syntax #RRGGBBAA with alpha in the last two digits; parser-tags.html: Opacity 'opacity defaults to 1, range 0..1, applies to the whole subtree'

samples.index_note: the (origin_x+180, origin_y+100)-th pixel of the decoded PNG, 0-based
samples.actual_note: filled by tmp/run-20261011-01/A10/scripts/sample_a10.py from the final service PNG (RGBA, unpremultiplied 8-bit)
composition_steps: start from the white panel: dst = (255,255,255), alpha = 1
step 2 blue #0000FF80 on top: src = (0,0,255), a = 128/255
samples.alpha_note: 0x80 = 128, and 128/255 = 0.5019607843137255 != 0.5; using exactly 0.5 would give [127.5, 63.75, 191.25] -> [128, 64, 191], i.e. one unit higher in R and G than the 0.501961 result [127, 63, 191]. 128/255 and 0.5 are different alphas and must not be conflated.

samples.index_note: the (origin_x+180, origin_y+100)-th pixel of the decoded PNG, 0-based
samples.actual_note: filled by tmp/run-20261011-01/A10/scripts/sample_a10.py from the final service PNG (RGBA, unpremultiplied 8-bit)
composition_steps: inside Opacity(0.5) the two opaque children composite first (alpha 1 each):
group layer at the sample = blue (0,0,255) because blue is painted last on top
the layer is blended once onto the white panel: a = 0.5
samples.alpha_note: group opacity applies a single 0.5 blend of the finished layer; it is not the same as giving each child alpha 128/255. A per-child (incorrect) opacity-0.5 composite would yield [127.5, 63.75, 191.25] -> [128, 64, 191], which fails the <=3 channel tolerance against [128, 128, 255].
samples.contrast_with_panel1: panel 1 blends twice (red over white, then blue over the result) with a = 128/255; panel 2 blends once with a = 0.5

visual_checks.question: 背景是否被模糊、文字是否清晰、效果是否外溢到卡外

observations.text_evidence: 整图与 crops/panel3.png 中 'SHARP / BLUR' 字样完全可读，字形边缘最大逐像素灰度梯度 192.7 gray/px（面板4同一字带仅 8.7），红条与绿圆边缘同样锐利
observations.background_evidence: 卡内只含条纹的行带 (local y=100/104/108) 最大水平梯度 [4.0, 4.0, 4.0] gray/px，而卡外同一 24px 条纹场 (y=210/220/230) 为 [188.0, 188.0, 188.0] gray/px；卡内条纹呈柔和渐变带，正是 BackdropFilter σ=6 读取并模糊卡下背景的结果
observations.outside_evidence: 与共享同一基础场景的面板4逐像素比较 36784 个卡外像素，最大通道差 0（差异像素 0），卡外条纹相位/宽度一致且锐利，模糊未外溢

dsl_evidence: ClipRRect borderRadius=20 包住 BackdropFilter 与其后绘制的 Text/前景
BackdropFilter sigmaX=sigmaY=6 的子节点是半透明卡底 Container(#FFFFFF99)，按文档'读取已有背景，子节点随后照常绘制在模糊结果之上'实现毛玻璃

visual_checks.question: 同一场景整体子树模糊后，文字/背景/前景是否一起变模糊、卡外是否不变

observations.text_evidence: 'SHARP / BLUR' 字样在 crops/panel4.png 中不可辨认，同一字带最大梯度仅 8.7 gray/px，约为面板3清晰字形（192.7）的 1/22
observations.background_evidence: 卡内条纹与卡底、圆角边缘一起呈整体柔化（ImageFiltered 对整个子树输出施加 σ=6 高斯模糊，先绘制子节点再对结果滤波），与面板3'仅背景模糊、前景锐利'形成对照
observations.foreground_evidence: 红条与绿圆边缘出现宽渐变过渡带（σ=6 半径量级），面板3同位置为单像素锐利边缘
observations.outside_evidence: 与面板3共享场景的卡外 36784 个像素零差异（max diff 0），区外条纹保持同一清晰背景，模糊被 ClipRRect 限定在圆角卡内

dsl_evidence: ClipRRect borderRadius=20 > ImageFiltered sigmaX=sigmaY=6 > Stack(白底 + 与面板对齐的同相位条纹 + 卡底 + 文字 + 红条 + 绿圆)
与面板3唯一的差别是模糊作用的层：面板3只模糊卡下背景，面板4模糊同一范围的整个子树

observations.multiply_evidence: 蓝条 #2563EB 经 #F6B94A MULTIPLY 后变为深青色（采样 local (40,100) = (51, 82, 73)），整体呈暖黄罩色；透明间隙被滤色着色，与 ColorFiltered/MULTIPLY 对边界内透明像素同样参与混合的行为一致（文档说明部分混合模式会给透明间隙着色）
observations.blur_evidence: 条形、深色矩形与阴影边缘均为 σ=6 的宽渐变过渡（crops/panel5.png 可见）
observations.scope_evidence: local (40,100) 距⑥圆心 121.66px（>r=100），面板5该点仍为着色内容 (51, 82, 73) 而非白底，证明面板5没有圆形裁剪，效果范围=整个子树（含模糊外扩），四周留白为面板底色
observations.shadow_evidence: 阴影 boxShadow 经 MULTIPLY+模糊后仍表现为橙色矩形下缘的柔和暗晕，证明滤色+模糊保留了半透明阴影信息

dsl_evidence: ImageFiltered sigmaX=sigmaY=6 > ColorFiltered color=#F6B94A blendMode=MULTIPLY > Stack(条形段/深色矩形/阴影矩形)
先 ColorFiltered(MULTIPLY) 对内容着色，再对结果做子树高斯模糊（嵌套顺序即渲染顺序）
